data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 120.9m (2020: GBP 473.6m) is a deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Pandemic contributed to elevated claims activity and reserve volatility in 2020 and affected subsequent reserve development; the report notes a high frequency of natural catastrophe events and Covid-19 impacts on results.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 Syndicate 1861 reported opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 770.971m. Using the published gross claims development table, prior-year development for pre-2021 underwriting years shows an adverse (strengthening) movement of approximately GBP 34.52m (c. 4.5% of opening gross claims reserves), primarily driven by adverse claims development on the 2019 underwriting year. The report cites a mix of factors including large loss development, natural catastrophe activity and Covid-19 related effects; reinsurance arrangements (including an LPT in December 2021 and earlier RITC adjustments) also influenced reported reinsurance recoveries and reserve presentation.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 120.9m (2020: GBP 473.6m) is a deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
unprecedented Covid-19 pandemic and a high frequency of natural catastrophe events
Despite further Covid-19 enforced restrictions in 2021, the Syndicate has had favourable movement in Covid-19 losses of GBP 1.3m.

In December 2021 CMA entered into a Loss Portfolio Transfer Reinsurance (LPT) agreement with RiverStone Managing Agency Limited ("RiverStone") covering the majority of classes of business no longer written by Syndicates 4444 (2020 & prior years of account) and 1861 (2020 year of account only).
At 31 December 2020 the 2018 & Prior years of account closed by way of an external reinsurance to close agreement.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the gross claims development table (gross triangle) by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years 2019. The report contains RITC adjustments (2018 & prior) and an LPT (Dec 2021) which affect presentation and comparability of technical provisions; some narrative figures refer to net movements (post-reinsurance) and are therefore not directly comparable to gross movements. The explicit narrative line re prior-year movement (GBP 0.8m deterioration) refers to a net/included-in-net amount; the gross PYD here is calculated from the gross triangle. RITC/LPT transactions may distort year-on-year movements.
